source.author: William Lilly
source.read_mode: Direct original 1647 printed p535–536 facsimile examined, source edits versioned; no new Greek manuscript critical edition or independently settled future planetary strength

source_claims.source_wording_short: then take the Lord of the ascendant
source_claims.operationalization: If S1 AND S2 have no eligible planet under the declared original-source variants, the ascending-sign traditional domicile ruler is the provisional historical S3 potential planet

source_claims.source_wording_short: his Dispositor behold him with some aspect
source_claims.operationalization: Require a DISTINCT domicile dispositor of natal ASC lord to aspect that lord; separately preserve sign-based and source-orb-near traditional nonconjunction rays, not a single unique historical numerical threshold
A distinct classical body aspects ASC lord, but ASC lord's own domicile dispositor does not; original p536 does not unambiguously nominate any lord/other body or permit forcing a later partile stage

When ASC lord is in its OWN domicile, its domicile dispositor is itself. A planet cannot make an ordinary different-body aspect to itself. This original source case is preserved as unassigned SY and explicitly split from earlier S4/S5 or SX historical numeric bins rather than secretly invent an aspect.

Two independent possible interpretations: traditional non-bodily sign or near-rayed aspects vs those aspects plus any BODY conjunction with the lord. No one source unique definition assigned to every chart.

source_method_variants.source_s3_candidate_identity: Domicile ruler of rising sign, not the other planet aspecting it and not the ASC lord's dispositor by default
source_method_variants.source_SX_aspector_identity_policy: Retain ALL other classic-planet aspectors, not a source-authorized alternative final manner significator

reconciliation_formula: New S1,S2,S3 equal old S1,S2,S3 exactly for both old partile variants
Old SX = New SX (other body, no distinct dispositor) + New SY where another planet also aspects lord
Old S4 + old S5 = New LATER (no planet aspects and not self) + New SY where no other planet aspects lord
All new 6 independent source statuses S1 S2 S3 SY SX LATER partition every clock time

unresolved_historical_outcomes: Self-dispositor S3 versus no-other-planet fallback, original p536 meaning not source unique
Original other planet aspect without dispositor SX is a gap, not an implicit fully resolved different significator
Original S4 forcibly partile and S5 most essential dignity at Mercury/Moon locations
Full 1647 planetary strength and actual matter-significator eligibility
Ptolemy III.13 fifth mode, original contrary and sect testimony
Complete non-bespoke human-characteristic scoring and independent private observation against null baselines
